title: Delay Credit Amount and Credit Base on Deposit-Program Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
**Determination.** The credit base of a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent is the order total billed plus every home delivery fee billed on the order, less every damage allowance credited on it. The delay credit is the program's delay credit percentage of the credit base, rounded to the nearest cent and never more than the program's delay credit maximum.

## Terms used

- **The order total billed** is the amount of the order billing line on the order.
- **Every home delivery fee billed** is the total of the home delivery fee lines on the order; **every damage allowance credited** is the total of the damage allowance credit lines on the order.
- The program's delay credit percentage and delay credit maximum are the figures of the order's program in the Ridgeline Special Order Services lead time and vendor delay schedule.
- **Order of operations.** The percentage is applied to the credit base, the result is rounded to the nearest cent, and the rounded figure is then held to no more than the maximum.

## Worked figures (hypothetical orders at a 5 percent program percentage)

| Order total billed | Home delivery fees | Damage allowances | Credit base | Maximum | Delay credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3200.00 | 99.00 | 0.00 | 3299.00 | 250.00 | 164.95 |
| 3200.00 | 99.00 | 480.00 | 2819.00 | 250.00 | 140.95 |
| 12000.00 | 149.00 | 0.00 | 12149.00 | 500.00 | 607.45 held to 500.00 |

## Basis questions

**Do damage allowances lower the credit?** Yes. Every damage allowance credited on the order is taken off the credit base.

**Does a home delivery fee raise it?** Yes. Every home delivery fee billed on the order is added to the credit base.
